themeWhy: kraft-paper keys in the brown family of the wooden cube and the cardboard, with a magenta-marker Enter as the treat; never red or violet

images.why: Description 'Fill solids with unit cubes' and Look 'a tray of violet unit cubes ... Unit cube': every unit cube (the tray, the rows, the stack, the shelf cubes) is one wooden toy block, tinted violet in code
images.prompt: A single pale natural beechwood toy building block in the shape of a perfect cube, with softly rounded edges, a fine smooth wood grain and a light honey-cream colour. It is shown in an isometric view looking down at one corner, like a cube icon, so a top face and two side faces all show and the outline is a hexagon.

images.why: Description 'an open shoebox and an open pencil box' (phase 1 screen): the faces of each open box and of every box-shaped solid are kraft cardboard, clipped to each face, the edges drawn in code
images.prompt: A single flat rectangular sheet of plain light-brown kraft cardboard, with a fine paper-fibre grain on a smooth, even surface and a thin, slightly rough rim showing the corrugated layer inside.
